plain_english: Unscrutinized, the self never comes to share in thing-knowing; unscrutinized, it is not at all without the grasping course. But Śiva — that self shining, one sap of all things — hence I, heart-devoted to Your hymn, am ever blissful.
sanskrit_cite: anāmṛṣṭaḥ svātmā na hi bhavati bhāvapramitibhāj | śivaś cāsau svātmā sphurad akhilabhāvaikasarasas
